title: Trace thread curator and PagerDuty quick-playbook crafter
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: On-call responders get noisy PagerDuty alerts with links to sprawling traces. Investigators waste time opening many spans and correlating logs to assemble a concise next-actions list. We need a lightweight server-side curator that samples the most relevant contiguous trace thread, synthesizes a short diagnostic brief, and attaches a suggested 'quick playbook' (3-4 prioritized remediation steps) into PagerDuty alert payloads and Slack cards. Goal: reduce median time-to-first-action for latency/error alerts by surfacing a focused trace thread + actionable steps in the PD/Slack context.
acceptance_criteria: PD alerts for high-latency and 5xx incidents include a curated trace thread URL that opens to a pre-filtered trace view
PD alert payload contains a 3-step quick-playbook derived from trace heuristics and runbook templates
Slack incident card shows the same curated trace thread, a short 1-2 sentence summary, and buttons: 'Open Trace', 'Run Quick Playbook', 'Create Postmortem'
Feature respects tenant data retention/PII settings and can be disabled per-customer via flags
End-to-end integration covered by unit and e2e tests; rollout feature-flagged with gradual percentage ramp
Observed median time-to-first-action reduced in canary from baseline by >=15% (measured via oncall-timing metric)
tasks: Design trace-thread selection heuristics and scoring (latency contribution, error spans, service boundary hops)
Implement trace curator service: sampling, canonicalization, short-link generation (signed, 24h TTL)
Create quick-playbook generator mapping trace signals to templated operator steps
Extend PD webhook payloads to attach curator brief + JSON quick-playbook and action links
Add Slack card renderer and actionable buttons wired to ops endpoints
Add feature flags and tenant-level opt-out controls in private deployments
Add observability: metrics on curator success rate, quick-playbook acceptance, and time-to-first-action
Write unit tests, integration tests, and post-deploy smoke tests
Update runbooks and internal docs with sample PD/Slack payloads and security considerations
implementation_notes: Curator runs as a lightweight side service in ops plane; it subscribes to high-priority incident events from internal event-bus
Trace selection uses a hybrid score: error_weight * error_span_fraction + latency_weight * p99_latency_contrib + boundary_penalty. Tunable per-customer via config
Short-link generation signs a payload with infra KMS; link resolves through console with ephemeral view token scoped to the incident
Quick-playbook templates live in a policy repo; generator is rule-based with fallback to a minimal generic checklist
Respect existing KV cache and sampling: curator should not trigger additional full-trace ingestion for high-volume customers; use available sampled spans first
Rate-limit attachments per-incident to avoid PD payload size limits; attach JSON blob plus a reference link to full brief in console
rollout_plan: 1) Feature gated behind account flag. 2) Internal Canary: enable for Redwood SRE workspace for 2 weeks. 3) Beta customers opt-in via console toggle. 4) Ramp to 20% hosted accounts after validating metrics and PD rate behavior. 5) Enable tenant opt-out and provide config for private deployments.
monitoring: alert: curator-shortlink-failure if >3% of incidents missing attachment over 10m
